const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for the rcb-limited food_packing2_cans episode.
+
+Run this once and send one JSON command per line on stdin. Camera snapshots and
+action results are saved beside this script so each move can be checked before
+the next one is planned.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+
+def save_images(prefix, images):
+    for cam, arr in images.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(arr)).save(OUT / f"{prefix}_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+
+def reply(obj):
+    print(json.dumps(obj, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+
+reply({"ready": True, "protocol": spec.get("protocol"), "control_hz": spec.get("control_hz"),
+       "action_types": spec.get("action_types"), "robot_spec": spec.get("robot_spec"),
+       "world": spec.get("world"), "proprio_groups": spec.get("proprio_groups"),
+       "cameras": spec.get("cameras"), "budget": spec.get("budget")})
+
+while True:
+    line = sys.stdin.readline()
+    if not line:
+        break
+    try:
+        c = json.loads(line)
+        op = c.get("cmd")
+        if op == "obs":
+            o = r.get_obs(depth=c.get("depth", True), video="none")
+            save_images("obs", o.last)
+            for cam, arr in o.last_depth.items():
+                np.save(OUT / f"obs_depth_{cam}.npy", arr)
+            reply({"ok": True, "files": [f"obs_{cam}.jpg" for cam in o.last],
+                   "proprio": o.meta.get("proprio"), "cameras": o.meta.get("cameras"),
+                   "depth_stats": {k: {"shape": list(v.shape), "valid": int(np.count_nonzero(v)),
+                                       "min": float(v[v > 0].min()) if np.any(v > 0) else None,
+                                       "max": float(v.max())} for k, v in o.last_depth.items()},
+                   "status": r.status()})
+        elif op == "submit":
+            res = r.submit(c["type"], c["actions"], dt=c.get("dt"), video="none",
+                           depth=c.get("depth", "none"), note=c.get("note", ""))
+            save_images("last", res.last)
+            for cam, arr in res.last_depth.items():
+                np.save(OUT / f"last_depth_{cam}.npy", arr)
+            reply({"ok": True, "meta": res.meta, "last_files": [f"last_{cam}.jpg" for cam in res.last],
+                   "last_proprio": res.meta.get("proprio"), "status": r.status()})
+        elif op == "status":
+            reply({"status": r.status()})
+        elif op == "quit":
+            reply({"bye": True})
+            break
+        else:
+            reply({"error": f"unknown command {op!r}"})
+    except Exception as e:
+        reply({"error": type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e)})
*** End Patch";
